title: OPERATOR
provenance: Reported by DrBendy23 (highball-db#854, 2026-11-01), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes: about four hours in the notes, a raid against bots and then online servers, a steady 55 fps (capped) at 1080p with DLSS through MetalFX on Quality and the Medium preset, with BepInEx through winhttp=n,b. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on an M3 Pro with DXMT on the default engine, online play included, at a capped 55 fps at 1080p on Medium. The first launch takes a few minutes. Night vision and aiming look slightly blurry by design, and a narrower window sharpens them.
